changeSet.author: PuneetGupta
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[UserAssetPermissionsByAssetID] ( @ResourceID int, @AssetTypeID int, @AssetID bigint ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( With AssetRule as ( select a.AssetTypeID, rasset.AssetID, rasset.RuleID from [dbo].[asset] a inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.AssetID = a.ID) where a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and a.id = @AssetID union all select att.ID as AssetTypeID, rasset.AssetID, rasset.RuleID from [dbo].[assettype] att inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.AssetID = 0 and rasset.AssetTypeID = att.ID) inner join dbo.responsibilitytyperelationrule r on (r.ID = rasset.RuleID) where att.ID = @AssetTypeID and r.ApplyToType = 1 ) select rel.PermissionsBitMask, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID from AssetRule rasset inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] r on (r.id = rasset.RuleID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] rel on (rel.ObjectID = r.ObjectID and rel.ResponsibilityTypeID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID and rel.ObjectType = r.[Object]) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.id = rresource.RuleID) where rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' and rresource.SecurityAssetID = @ResourceID union all select rel.PermissionsBitMask, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID from AssetRule rasset inner join [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationrule] r on (r.id = rasset.RuleID) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] rel on (rel.ObjectID = r.ObjectID and rel.ResponsibilityTypeID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID and rel.ObjectType = r.[Object]) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.id = rresource.RuleID) inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID where RG.ResourceID = @resourceId union all select rr.PermissionsBitMask, oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join [dbo].ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'R' where oride.assetID = @AssetID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and RES.ResourceID = @ResourceID union all select rr.PermissionsBitMask, oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join [dbo].ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join dbo.[Group] G on G.ID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'G' inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID where oride.assetID = @AssetID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and RG.ResourceID = @ResourceID union all select A.PermissionsBitMask, A.AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from dbo.AssetType T cross apply (select ResourceID,IsAdministrator from reporting.Global_Resource where ResourceID = @ResourceID and IsAdministrator = 0) R cross apply GetAssetsOfDefaultPermissions(@ResourceID,@AssetTypeID,T.DefaultPermissions,R.IsAdministrator, 0) A where A.AssetID = @AssetID and T.ID = @AssetTypeID and T.DefaultPermissions = 0 )
